Introduction

Jhnovr is a South Korean hip-hop singer-songwriter and independent artist. He initially performed under the stage name New Day, debuting with the digital single Birthday Suit. He officially debuted as Jhnovr in 2017 under the underground label Badtrip, releasing his first mini-album Escape From The Late Night. Known for his moody, introspective sound and lyrical depth, he has remained active in the Korean underground hip-hop scene.

Following his time with Badtrip, Jhnovr became affiliated with Wedaplugg Records, while continuing to operate independently. He has since released several notable works, including the EPs Mechanism and Dirty Messiah (2019), and his first full-length album A Nocturnal Visit (2020). His later projects include Human Nature (2022) and a series of digital singles such as Fxxk U, Something (2024), and Hate&Love (2025). Balancing label collaborations with independent activity, Jhnovr has built a distinct identity in Korea’s hip-hop landscape.
